Now, six years later, whenever youkai wish for their problems to be solved, they make their way to Kotoko for consultation. 
 
Meanwhile, Kurou Sakuragawa, a 22-year-old university student, has just broken up with his girlfriend after he fled alone when the two encountered a kappa. Seeing this as her chance to become closer with him, Kotoko immediately makes her move, hoping to get married to Kurou one day. However, she quickly realizes there is something more to Kurou. With this knowledge, she asks for his help in solving the various issues presented by the supernatural, all the while wishing her newfound partner will eventually reciprocate her feelings.

about|series|dive into you.url: Fantasy Romance  Yun Ha Na is a top actress adored across Asia, living a glamorous life at the height of her career. But after a mysterious accident causes her soul to switch with that of her twin brother, Yun Ha Ru, she suddenly finds herself thrown back into the past. Faced with a second chance to change fate, Ha Na becomes determined to save her first love, Jung U Jae — a former judo prodigy turned bodyguard who once lost his life protecting her. As Ha Na struggles to navigate the past in the midst of unexpected chaos, Ha Ru must cope with waking up in his sister's body, leading to a series of unpredictable and emotional moments. Alongside them is Son Ye Rang, Ha Na's powerful agency CEO and Ha Ru's devoted lover, whose strong exterior hides a deeply vulnerable side. Four young people whose intertwined destinies challenge love, sacrifice, and the possibility of rewriting the past.

about|series|elsbeth.url: Drama Comedy Crime   Elsbeth  follows Elsbeth Tascioni, an astute but unconventional attorney who utilizes her singular point of view to make unique observations and corner brilliant criminals alongside the NYPD. After leaving her successful legal career in Chicago to tackle a new investigative role in New York City, Elsbeth finds herself jockeying with the toast of the NYPD, Captain C.W. Wagner, a charismatic and revered leader. Working alongside Elsbeth is Officer Kaya Blanke, a stoic and ethical officer who quickly develops an appreciation for Elsbeth's insightful and offbeat ways.

about|series|firefly wedding.url: Drama Anime Romance  Satoko Kirigaya has everything a noblewoman could want—except time. With her life running out, she's determined to marry well and make her father proud. But when a ruthless assassin kidnaps her, she makes a desperate offer: "Marry me, and we'll have it all." Shinpei Goto accepts, only to become dangerously obsessed. Now Satoko must choose between duty and a love that could consume them both.

about|series|where the mask ends.url: Drama Romance  Chou was once a lowly night-soil collector, bullied and mistreated by everyone around her. But her striking resemblance to Wei Rao, the daughter of a marquis, unexpectedly makes her the bride of Lu Zhuo, the heir to a duke's household, in a marriage arranged to bring him good fortune and save his life. Ambitious and determined to rise above her station, Chou sees the marriage as her chance to climb the social ladder. However, her critically ill husband suddenly awakens, and her assumption of another woman's place brings one disaster after another. Furious that Chou has taken her place, Wei Rao is desperate to get rid of her. Meanwhile, Lu Zhuo regards Chou as a vicious and scheming woman, constantly guarding against her and plotting against her. Beneath the seemingly harmonious facade of the duke's household lie countless traps and deadly schemes. Caught in the midst of these hidden conflicts, Chou struggles to navigate the competing interests around her while carefully planning her future. Determined to break free from the shackles of fate, she eventually uncovers the secrets of her own origins and reunites with her loved ones. Rising from a humble night-soil collector to a woman of status, she transforms her life and creates a brilliant future for herself.
